summary.oneLiner: One of India's leading circular-economy players, recovering and recycling end-of-life energy storage products and non-ferrous scrap into pure lead and lead alloys of 99.97%-99.985% purity.
summary.business: Ardee Industries Limited recycles used lead-acid batteries and other recyclable scrap (battery scrap, remelted lead ingots and blocks, lead scrap from radio/relay/ropes, lead master metal) into pure lead and customisable lead alloys - lead calcium, lead antimony, lead tin, lead silver and lead cadmium - at a single 7.61-acre facility in Tirupati district, Andhra Pradesh with 104,025 MTPA installed capacity.
